# 佛滅度後棺斂葬送經

**ID:** T0392
**Volume:** T12
**Category:** 涅槃部類
**Original Category:** 涅槃部
**Byline:** 失譯
**Date:** 265–316
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0392

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle anonymous text treats the funerary arrangements for the Buddha after his *parinirvāṇa* — the placement in the coffin, the cremation, and the funeral procession. Together with [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù's *Bān ní huán hòu guàn là jīng* 般泥洹後灌臘經 ([KR6g0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0036), T0391) it is part of the *post-Niè-pán* ritual-narrative cycle of Chinese Buddhist texts.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (350–600) reflects the broad pre-Táng period during which the work was likely composed.
